lines.ko: 넷 중 진짜를 고르는 게임을 열었습니다.
lines.en: A new game: find the one real name out of four.
The real apartments now come from 2,889 complexes in Seoul.
A daily round grew from 3 to 10 questions.

lines.ko: 문제마다 제한시간이 붙어서 15초 안에 골라야 합니다.
lines.en: Each question has a clock; you pick within 15 seconds.
Even after you finish, more questions keep coming.

lines.ko: 지어낸 가짜 이름 104개를 실제 목록과 대조했습니다.
lines.en: I checked my 104 invented fake names against the real list.
Seven of them were actual apartments in Seoul.

lines.ko: 나머지 두 게임도 결과 그림을 만들 차례입니다.
lines.en: Next: shareable result images for the other two games.
lines.art: a tiny robot pressing a red ink stamp onto two blank paper cards

lines.en: I invented fakes and ran into the real thing.

failCard.title: 지어낸 이름이 실제로 있었다
failCard.beforeEn: 104 names I was sure I had invented
failCard.afterEn: Dropped 7 of them and wrote replacements

captions.ko: 넷 중 진짜 아파트를 고르는 게임을 열었습니다. 지어낸 가짜 이름 104개를 서울 실제 목록과 대조했더니 7개가 정말 있는 아파트였습니다.
captions.en: Opened a new game: find the one real apartment out of four. I checked 104 invented fake names against Seoul's real list, and seven of them actually exist.
